description: Register another bag of a coffee that is already in list_beans — the same roaster's product, bought again. It keeps the coffee's recipes, notes and history; only the purchase facts (roast date, weight, price, state) are new. Does not change the active coffee. Returns a bag_id: bag numbers are their own series, separate from bean numbers. For a coffee that is not in list_beans yet, call register_coffee instead.

bag_notes.description: Notes about THIS bag (a batch note, where it was bought). The coffee's own description lives on the coffee, in notes.

bean_id.description: This account's own coffee number, from list_beans. Never guess one.

best_by_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

buy_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

opened_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

roast_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

state.description: Defaults to sealed; the first log_shot against it opens it

name: register_bag
title: Register a bag
